title: Retired unit continuity
responsibility: Finds retired identities continued through identical symbol lists or reuse of a name with a numeric suffix.

inputs.name: unitLineage.unit
inputs.description: Current unit id and ordered exported-symbol list.

inputs.name: unitLineage.retired
inputs.description: Candidate manifests to examine for retired predecessors.

outputs.name: unitLineage
outputs.description: Sorted predecessor ids, excluding the current id, whose nonempty symbols match in order or whose id is reused with a numeric suffix.
